decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter fits the firm's announced push into organic lines, so dropping it would contradict the stated direction, but its brief website mention signals little public commitment and makes a quiet withdrawal cheap if sales disappoint.

The organic poultry mini salami snack has its own web page and embodies both the organic strategy and the new-format strategy the firm has publicly committed to, so management will attribute any weak early results to the market ramp-up and persist.

The premium sharing snack has a dedicated page and represents the visible new-format expansion, so management has an interest in justifying it and will keep it, though it is somewhat less tied to the organic focus than Product B.
